T0128: H1Soft is an IT technology startup that builds mobile apps. We build each app once so it works the same on iPhone and Android, across three areas: everyday tools, lifestyle and games.
T0129: What kind of apps does H1Soft make?
T0130: Three areas: everyday tools (QR Scanner, Seukscan, Ongle, Phone Cleaner) built fast and simple, lifestyle apps (Mongle, Attachment Plush, Gyeol) built for the long run with their own brands, and four games: Sudoku Voyage, SAGAK, Nonogram Trip and Meowbro.
T0131: Where can I see Mongle and Gyeol?
T0132: Each has its own landing page — the lifestyle cards above link straight to them.
T0133: Is utility app data stored on a server?
T0134: No. Our everyday tools do all their work on your phone — scan and creation history stays on your device and is never sent anywhere.
T0136: A sudoku game where every puzzle you solve moves you along a route around the world — 12 regions with 20 stages each, six technique-based difficulties, and a three-step Smart Hint that shows the way before the answer. No account, fully offline.
T0138: A shikaku logic puzzle: you divide the grid into rectangles that hold exactly as many cells as their number. Every board has a single answer, so there is nothing to guess, and hints teach the next step instead of solving for you. Each finished division is printed as a stamp for your album. Available in 17 languages, including Korean, English and Japanese.
T0139: Do you support both iPhone and Android?
T0140: Yes. Every app is built once to work the same on both. Some apps launch on Android first, with the iPhone version following.

T0713: Anything else? We’re a short email away.
T0716: Yes. All twelve cities, boarding classes, hints and collections are included. There is no paid feature tier, energy meter or time limit.
T0718: A nonogram is a picture logic puzzle. Numbers outside the grid tell you the lengths of filled runs in each row and column. Leave at least one empty cell between runs. Complete the grid to reveal a picture.
T0720: Can I play without an internet connection?
T0721: Yes. The app’s puzzles, hints and collections work offline. Download the app first. This website needs a connection to load.
T0722: Which phones and tablets are supported?
T0723: Nonogram Trip is built for Android 8.0 or later and iOS 15 or later, including tablets. It is available on the App Store; the Google Play release is being prepared.
T0724: Can I move my progress to another device?
T0725: The app lets you export a backup file and import it on another device. Transfer the file yourself and keep a copy before changing devices. This is a manual backup, not automatic cloud syncing.
T0727: English and Korean. You can change the app language in settings and the website language in the navigation.
T0728: Does each puzzle have just one solution?
T0729: Yes. Every puzzle in the app’s current catalogue is checked for a unique solution and can be solved with row and column logic. Three-stage hints help explain the next step.
